summary: Proposal for Game#810, companion to ADR0001; source draft, not an accepted or shipped contract. ClientEffect instantiates the game's existing Local type without extending GuestIntent. Selection, highlights and plans stay client-only beside authoritative and marked predicted state. A plan draft commits and links through a game-owned planOf command accessor, survives rebind/backend changes and follows settlement. The default game-overridable codec uses version1 little-endian Q24.8 coordinates and pinned golden vectors. Proposed pass order is amplifiers, bodies, plans, brackets, cues; proposed plan inks use five plan.* aliases. Selection reaches aria-selected and each plan has a polite announcement and text summary. The experimental ReferenceGame proof uses a synchronous F# guest stand-in, not an actual WASM execution proof, and lives outside packed libraries. The cited design owns the remaining questions and staged implementation. Input host, glyph and theme owners must confirm their proposed APIs/pass/tokens; supplier stack reconciliation, browser conformance and cross-runtime production laws are separate evidence obligations. Do not infer acceptance, current supplier compatibility or consumer adoption from this record.
title: Proposed guest-local selection and planning presentation contract
